prompt: What does an amortized O(1) operation guarantee?
options: For every allowed operation sequence, total cost divided across the sequence is O(1) per operation, even if some individual operations are expensive.
Every individual operation has worst-case O(1) cost.
The expected cost is O(1) only under a random input distribution.
Only the first operation is O(1).
reason: Amortized analysis spreads infrequent expensive operations across many cheap operations.
details: It is a deterministic sequence guarantee, not a promise that each call is cheap.

wrongOptionExplanations.each_worst_constant: An occasional operation may be much more expensive.
wrongOptionExplanations.first_only: The claim concerns the sequence total.
wrongOptionExplanations.random_average: That describes average or expected analysis, not deterministic amortized analysis.
